title: K-flat descent for the transported published tensor comparison
statement: theorem publishedSystemTransportedTensor_eq_of_flat_normalized {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hflat : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ) (hP : @CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ℕ × Y.ProEt) (inferInstance : Category.{u} (ℕ × Y.ProEt)) (pullbackTensorSequenceSmall Y) (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y)) (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) P) (hQ : @CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (ℕ × Y.ProEt) (inferInstance : Category.{u} (ℕ × Y.ProEt)) (pullbackTensorSequenceSmall Y) (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y)) (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) Q) (flatP : SemilinearSections.flatTerms.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y)) (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) P) (flatQ : SemilinearSections.flatTerms.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y)) (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y) Q), (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E Y P Q hP hQ).hom ≫ (publishedSystemTransportedTensor l E f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫ (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q)) = (pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((pullbackTensorSequenceCochain l E f).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫ (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E X _ _ (pullbackTensorSequenceGood l E f P hP) (pullbackTensorSequenceGood l E f Q hQ)).hom) : publishedSystemTransportedTensor l E f = pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f

proof.text: Apply Iso.ext and the faithful-restriction clause of cochain_tensor_model_rigidity on the ringed sequence site of Y. It suffices to identify the hom components of the two comparisons on each pair of K-flat complexes whose terms are flat.

For each such pair P,Q, instantiate the hypothesis hflat and the defining representative equation of pullbackTensorSystemComparison_existsUnique. Their right-hand sides coincide, so transitivity gives equality of the two component maps after precomposition by the derived image of the tensor model and postcomposition by tensor applied to the exact-derived factorization maps. These two outer arrows are homs of explicit mapIso isomorphisms. Cancel them to get the component equality required by faithful restriction.
